title: Extra client-side call being made when navigating to Algolia page (Next 13, pages dir)
explanation: The user is reporting a bug with Algolia requests appearing unexpectedly when navigating to an Algolia page in a Next.js 13 project, which is frustrating and confusing as it did not happen in their previous Next.js 12 projects. The detailed steps to reproduce and the live demo provided suggest this is a technical issue requiring investigation.
